events_detected.summary: Iranian forces escalated harassment of tanker traffic in Strait of Hormuz. Only 8-15 vessels transiting daily vs ~130 pre-conflict. Iran conditions reopening on 6 US demands including lifting naval blockade, sanctions, withdrawing forces, paying reparations. Talks at impasse. Gold spiked above $4,400 on the news. EIA forecasts oil prices remain elevated until flows normalize.
events_detected.status_change: ESCALATING — tanker harassment intensified, gold spiked above $4,400

events_detected.title: US-Japan Joint Yen Intervention UNRAVELING — Yen Erases Half Gains
events_detected.summary: Historic joint US-Japan currency intervention (~$75bn Japan + $5-10bn US) has failed to hold. Yen erased ~50% of intervention gains less than 2 weeks later. US Treasury sold euros (not dollars) to avoid pushing US yields higher, blindsiding ECB. BOJ held rate at 1% during intervention, limiting effectiveness. Bessent-Takaichi rift on BOJ policy clouds coordinated defense. CNBC calls it 'weaponized yen' but fundamentals winning over intervention.
events_detected.status_change: NEW — intervention unraveling confirmed, yen erasing gains
